I actively manage 20+ coaching programs and communities....

The ones that reliably scale past $300K/month all have the same unfair advantage.

It’s a backend built to retain, renew, and ascend clients on purpose. Not by accident.

Three big mistakes people make:

1) “Onboarding” = a welcome email + portal login or some Philippines VA doing onboarding calls (lol)

2) No one owns student accountability except the founder

3) Hiring CSMs from their student pool and not professional account managers (real, common)

4) Upsells only happen when a client raises their hand and asks

One of the reasons I have consistently scaled clients to $500K/M+ is because they don't rely on the feast or famine of "new income" every month and can instead stack real MRR or stack new cash-injections from existing customers and then re-invest that into marketing easily.

DAHIL SA PAGSUSUNOG NG TANSO

BASAHIN: Naglabas ng pahayag ang lokal na pamahalaan ng Quezon City hinggil sa naganap na sunog kaninang madaling araw, Abril 30, sa NIA Road, Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City.

Ayon sa ulat ng BFP-QC, nagsimula ang sunog sa pagsusunog ng tanso sa isang abandonadong bahay.

Humihiling naman ang pamahalaan na tigilan ang pagpapakalat ng maling impormasyon na sinadya ang sunog sa lugar matapos itong masunog noong Marso 6. | DRZH News

Courtesy: Quezon City Government
